definitions.gloss: completion; finish; result (of work or a game)
stepping up into a house; entryway; green tea (at a sushi restaurant)

examples.japanese: {売|う}り{上|あ}がりが{増|ふ}えた。
{今月|こんげつ}の{上|あ}がりは{先月|せんげつ}より{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This month's earnings are more than last month's.

examples.japanese: {物価|ぶっか}の{上|あ}がりが{止|と}まらないので{家計|かけい}が{苦|くる}しい。
examples.english: The rise in prices won't stop, so our household budget is tight.

examples.japanese: きれいな{上|あ}がりだね。
{写真|しゃしん}の{上|あ}がりを{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: I'll check how the photos turned out.

examples.japanese: この{料理|りょうり}は{上|あ}がりが{早|はや}いから、{忙|いそが}しい{日|ひ}にぴったりだ。
examples.english: This dish finishes quickly, so it's perfect for busy days.
Here's your tea (at a sushi restaurant).

examples.japanese: {靴|くつ}を{脱|ぬ}いで{上|あ}がりにお{上|あ}がりください。
examples.english: Please take off your shoes and step up into the entryway.

examples.japanese: お{寿司屋|すしや}さんで{最後|さいご}に{上|あ}がりを{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: I ordered tea at the end of my meal at the sushi restaurant.

notes:
The noun form of the verb {上|あ}がる. Has a wide range of meanings depending on context, from financial gains to the quality of a finished product.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {売|う}り{上|あ}がり: sales, revenue
- {出来|でき}{上|あ}がり: completion, finished product
- {仕上|しあ}がり: finishing, final result
- {物価|ぶっか}の{上|あ}がり: rise in prices
- {上|あ}がり{框|がまち}: entryway step (in a Japanese house)

SUSHI RESTAURANT USAGE:
At sushi restaurants, {上|あ}がり is the traditional term for green tea. This is part of the specialized vocabulary (sushi terminology) used at the counter. Customers may use this word to request tea at the end of their meal.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上昇|じょうしょう}: rise, ascent — more formal and used for measurable increases
- {収入|しゅうにゅう}: income — specifically refers to money earned
- {完成|かんせい}: completion — emphasizes the finished state of a project or work
